column7: client.Encrypt (internal/crypto/awskms/awskms.go) returned a KMS Encrypt response's CiphertextBlob completely unchecked; a 2xx response with a missing/empty/null CiphertextBlob was treated as a successful wrap. kms_provider.go's generateAndWrap then persisted this empty blob verbatim to the wrapped-KEK file via securefiles.SecureWriteFileSync (which also has no length check) -- first-run startup appeared to succeed, but the persisted file was unusable on the next restart. Found by a private pre-disclosure fuzzing pass on aws-sdk-go-v2's KMS client (mirror harness, since internal/ packages are cross-module unimportable); structurally identical to the already-fixed awssm.go SecretString=="" gap (docs/findings/2026-09-20-FINDING-awssm-empty-secret-response.md). Fixed by rejecting a zero-length CiphertextBlob as an error rather than returning it; red-before/green-after proving test confirmed by reverting the fix and re-running.
